title: Dedicated capacity handshake simulator and provisioning rulebook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Sales and customer success teams are signing Dedicated capacity commitments without a predictable, testable way to translate a requested throughput SLA into fleet reservations, autoscale policies, and buffer budgets. That mismatch has produced two customer incidents in Q4 where onboarding latency and throttled requests caused SLA breaches. Goal: Produce a prescriptive, simulation-backed provisioning rulebook and an interactive simulator that maps a customer throughput request to: reserved GPU pool size, minimum/maximum autoscale parameters, committed burst window, and recommended fallback variants. The deliverables will reduce manual engineering handoffs, produce a standard approval checklist, and power a self-serve estimate in the Console.
acceptance_criteria: Handbook: Clear step-by-step provisioning rulebook that maps 99th P99 token latency and desired RPS to reservation sizing and buffer allocation.
Simulator: Web-based simulator (POC) that ingests historical request profile, requested throughput guarantee, and returns suggested reservation size, min/max autoscale, and expected cost delta.
Approval flow: Decision matrix for sales/solutions that includes risk buckets, required approvals, and escalation paths for high-risk customers.
Integrations: Links to Console intake form and hooks for creating draft reservations in the provisioning system (read-only until eng signoff).
Metrics: Dashboards that show predicted vs actual utilization for the first 30 days of an onboarding and alert thresholds for under-provisioning risk.
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Research and modeling (2 sprints) - collect representative telemetry from Dedicated customers across throughput tiers and build a demand simulator that supports spike-and-decay and diurnal patterns.
Phase 2: Rulebook draft + approval matrix - define 'safe buffer' heuristics per hardware profile and model family. Trade-off: conservative buffers reduce SLA risk but increase committed cost.
Phase 3: Simulator POC and Console intake integration - engineering to provide API endpoints for model performance profiles and cost-estimate calculations.
Phase 4: Pilot with two existing customers (one AI-native, one enterprise) to validate simulator recommendations and tune policies.
Phase 5: Rollout - update playbooks for solutions and operations, add runbooks for post-onboard tuning and automatic buffer reclamation policies.
risks: Overfitting: Simulator trained on a small set of customers might not generalize to edge burst patterns.
Cost pushback: Sales may resist recommendations that materially increase committed spend vs current informal sizing practices.
Data sensitivity: Some customers will not provide request traces; we need anonymized or synthetic profile support.
Operational complexity: Introducing more knobs (burst window, min-replicas) increases operational burden without strong defaults.
rollout_plan: Internal alpha: 2-week internal pilot with Solutions Eng using the simulator against three queued onboarding requests.
Private pilot: Enable simulator for a small set of customers under Sales coordination; collect 30-day telemetry.
General availability: Console 'Estimate reservation' feature toggled on with audit trail and optional engineer signoff for tier-1 customers.
metrics_and_alerts: Prediction accuracy: mean absolute percentage error between predicted and observed CPU/GPU utilization over first 7 days < 20%.
SLA incidents: reduce Dedicated onboarding SLA breaches attributable to provisioning by 80% in the first 6 months.
Cost delta: surface projected committed cost change and track acceptance rate by Sales.
Post-onboard churn: monitor whether customers reduce reservation size within 90 days (sign of over-provisioning).
next_steps: Schedule working session with SRE and Serving runtime (ENG) to export anonymized request profiles (target: 10 representative workloads).
Draft approval matrix and risk buckets with Legal and SalesOps for review by 2026-03-20.
Create a minimal Console intake prototype that captures 'requested throughput', 'SLO target', and 'tolerance for cold starts'.
Assign ENG spike modeling task and tracking ticket ENG-47231 for simulator backend.
